faq.q: What is Feria San Bernabe in Marbella?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's largest annual fair, held in June. It features carnival rides, live music, casetas (tents), and traditional Andalusian food and drink. The 2042 edition runs from 7–15 June at the fairground near the bullring, a short taxi ride from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How do I get from Puerto Banús to the Feria San Bernabe fairground?
faq.a: It's a 5-minute taxi ride (about €10–15) from Puerto Banús to the fairground. Alternatively, you can walk in 25 minutes along the Avenida del Mar. Most boat parties dock back at Puerto Banús by 18:00, giving you plenty of time to head to the fair.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a Feria San Bernabe boat party?
faq.a: For up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m) includes a free jet ski and costs from €4,719 for 4 hours. For a smaller group of 9–11, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749/2h are excellent value. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is included in the boat party price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. You just need to bring swimwear and sunscreen.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and decorations for the boat party?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food, decorations, and music (Bluetooth speaker onboard). The crew can also arrange catering on request. Just avoid glass bottles for safety. Let us know on WhatsApp if you need anything special.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Feria San Bernabe charters?
faq.a: Cancellations made more than 14 days before departure receive a full refund. Between 7 and 14 days, 50% refund. Less than 7 days, no refund. We recommend travel insurance for peace of mind. Contact us via WhatsApp for any changes.

faq.q: Are children allowed on the boat parties?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on most boats. The Dubhe (5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are ideal for families with small kids. Life jackets are provided for all ages. Please inform us in advance so we can prepare appropriate safety gear.

faq.q: What time do boat parties typically depart during Feria San Bernabe?
faq.a: Most charters depart at 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, or 16:00 from Puerto Banús. A popular option is the 4-hour slot (14:00–18:00) followed by dinner and then the fair. You can also book an 8-hour day charter to explore the coast before the evening festivities.

data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2042 is the highlight of Marbella's summer calendar, and there's no better way to celebrate than with a boat party from Puerto Banús. Whether you're cruising before the fair or staying on the water all day, our fleet offers something for every group size and budget. Here's everything you need to know to plan your perfect day.

Why choose a boat party for Feria San Bernabe 2042?

Marbella's Feria San Bernabe runs from 7–15 June 2042, attracting thousands to the fairground near the bullring. A boat party lets you escape the crowds, enjoy the Mediterranean sunshine, and arrive at the fair relaxed and ready to party. With departures from Puerto Banús just 5 minutes by taxi from the fairground, you can combine a luxury yacht charter with the best of Marbella's traditional fair.

Pricing and inclusions

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours, with skipper, drinks, and VAT included. Tier B (Mangusta 80 variants) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request. Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. No hidden extras.

Sample itinerary for Feria San Bernabe 2042

  • 14:00 – Board at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper, and enjoy welcome drinks.
  • 14:30–17:30 – Cruise along the Marbella coastline, anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming and jet ski fun (on Mangusta 80).
  • 17:30 – Return to Puerto Banús, freshen up.
  • 18:30 – Taxi to the fairground (5 min, ~€12).
  • 19:00–late – Enjoy the fair, casetas, and live music.

Alternatively, book an 8-hour charter (€2,299 for Tier A) to explore Estepona or Sotogrande before heading to the fair.

What to bring and what to expect

Bring swimwear, sunscreen, a towel, and a light jacket for the evening. The average sea temperature in June is 21°C, and air temperatures reach 28°C. Sunglasses and a hat are recommended. You can bring your own food and decorations, but no glass bottles. Music is provided via Bluetooth speaker. The crew will ensure a safe and enjoyable experience.

Booking and contact

To reserve your boat for Feria San Bernabe 2042, contact us via WhatsApp or use the booking form on our site. Early booking is recommended as June is peak season. We accept payment by bank transfer or card. For any questions, reach out – we're happy to help you plan the ultimate boat party.
